source:
# Port of lib/pubid/itu/parser.rb — ITU-T/R/D designations: series codes
# (BT/G/V, SGnn), Imp implementation codes, OB Operational Bulletins,
# Reports, Study Group questions (numeric and bracketed series form),
# supplements (Suppl./Amd./Add./Err./Cor. with Technical marker), Annex
# and App. wraps, combined "/XX.N" designations, and the "| twin"
# common-text form. Internal rule `itu_identifier` corresponds to the
# source's `identifier` (renamed: PG forbids self-reference from the
# common-text wrapper).

grammar PubidItu version "0.1.0" {
  digit = %x30-39
  upper = %x41-5A
  lower = %x61-7A
  letter = upper
  digits = 1*digit
  space = " "
  dash = "-"
  dot = "."
  non_pipe = %x01-7B / %x7D-10FFFF

  itu_prefix = ("Recommendation " "ITU" (dash / space)) / ("ITU" (dash / space))
  sector = ("R" / "T" / "D") as sector
  series = (("SG" digits) / (1*3letter)) as series
  series_group = (letter [digits] dash digits) as series
  series_word = space "series" as series_word
  number = digits as number
  subseries = dot digits as subseries
  series_suffix_word = "bis" / "ter" / "quater" / "quarter"
  series_suffix = (series_suffix_word) as series_suffix
  series_suffix_spaced = (space as series_suffix_spaced) ((series_suffix_word) as series_suffix)
  qualifier_letter = ((%x41-52 / %x61-72) as qualifier) !(upper / lower / digit)
  qualifier_glued = qualifier_letter
  qualifier_spaced = (space as qualifier_spaced) qualifier_letter
  yyyymm_year = ("19" / "20") digit digit
  yyyymm_month = ("0" %x31-39) / ("1" %x30-32)
  yyyymm_shape = yyyymm_year yyyymm_month !digit
  yyyymm_date = dash (yyyymm_year) as year (yyyymm_month) as month !digit
  id_status = dash ("I" / "S") !(digit / letter)
  print_id_status = dash "I" !(digit / letter)
  id_date = yyyymm_date [print_id_status]
  document_date = (date_part / id_date)
  rec_word = ("REC" (space / dash))
  publication_id = sector dash "REC" dash series dot code yyyymm_date [id_status] [language]
  code_suffixes = [series_suffix_spaced] [qualifier_spaced]
  attachment = space "attachment" as attachment
  range_end = dash ((1*3letter dot digits) as range_end)
  part = dash !yyyymm_shape digits as part
  parts = (*part) as parts
  code = imp_code / standard_code
  standard_code = number [series_suffix] [subseries] parts [qualifier_glued]
  imp_code = "Imp" as imp_marker ((digits / (1*3letter)) as number) [subseries] parts
  date_part = space "(" [(digits as month "/")] ((4digit) as year) ")"
  version_part = space ((("(V" digits as version ")") / (("V" / "v") [dot] digits as version)))
  language = dash (("E" / "F" / "A" / "S" / "C" / "R") as language)

  combined_designation = "/" ((series dot digits as number [subseries] parts [qualifier_glued] [series_suffix_spaced] [qualifier_spaced]) as designation)
  combined_suffixes = (1*combined_designation) as combined

  technical_marker = "Technical" as technical space
  supplement_type = (("Suppl." / "Suppl" / "Amd." / "Amd" / "Add." / "Add" / "Err." / "Err") as supplement_type) / (([technical_marker] ("Cor." / "Cor") as supplement_type))
  supplement_number = ([space as supplement_space]) ((digits *(dot digits)) as supplement_number)
  supplement_date = space "(" [(digits as supplement_month "/")] ((4digit) as supplement_year) ")"

  base_with_series = itu_prefix sector space [rec_word] series dot code [range_end] code_suffixes [combined_suffixes] [series_word] [attachment] [version_part] [document_date]
  base_without_series = itu_prefix sector space code code_suffixes [attachment] [version_part] [document_date]
  series_code_body = !("OB" dash) ((2*letter) as series) (dash as series_dash) ((digits / (1*letter)) as number) parts
  contribution = itu_prefix sector space series ("-C" as contribution_marker) number parts [language]
  base_series_code = itu_prefix sector space series_code_body [version_part] [document_date]
  series_code_identifier = base_series_code [language]
  report_word = "Report" as report_marker
  report_body = !("OB" dot) [(series dot)] code [range_end] code_suffixes [series_word] [attachment] [version_part] [document_date]
  base_report = (report_word space itu_prefix sector space report_body) / (itu_prefix sector space report_word space report_body)
  report_identifier = base_report [language]
  base = base_report / base_with_series / base_without_series / base_series_code

  annex_label = letter [digits] ["+"]
  annex_body = (base as base) space "Annex" space annex_label as annex_number [document_date]
  annex_identifier = annex_body [language]
  roman = 1*(%x49 / %x56 / %x58)
  appendix_material = space (("test vectors" / "Software") as appendix_material)
  appendix_body = (base as base) space "App." [space] roman as appendix_number [appendix_material] [document_date]
  appendix_identifier = appendix_body [language]

  supplement_with_base = ((annex_body as base) / (appendix_body as base) / (base as base)) space supplement_type supplement_number [supplement_date] [language]
  chained_supplement = ((supplement_with_base / supplement_series_only) as base) space supplement_type supplement_number [supplement_date] [language]
  supplement_series_only = itu_prefix sector space (series_group / series) [series_word] space supplement_type supplement_number [supplement_date] [language]
  slash_chained_supplement = ((supplement_with_base) as base) ("/" as supplement_slash) supplement_type supplement_number [supplement_date] [language]
  supplement_identifier = chained_supplement / slash_chained_supplement / supplement_with_base / supplement_series_only

  with_series = itu_prefix sector space [rec_word] series dot code [range_end] code_suffixes [combined_suffixes] [series_word] [attachment] [version_part] [document_date] [language]
  without_series = itu_prefix sector space code code_suffixes [attachment] [version_part] [document_date] [language]

  roman_month = "XII" / "XI" / "IX" / "VIII" / "VII" / "VI" / "V" / "IV" / "III" / "II" / "I"
  ob_roman_date = " - " (2digit) as day dot (roman_month as roman_month) dot (4digit) as year
  ob_date = (date_part / ob_roman_date)
  ob_series = "OB" as series
  ob_dot_body = dot number
  ob_no_body = space "No." space number
  ob_bare_body = space number
  ob_with_sector = itu_prefix [(sector space)] ob_series (ob_dot_body / ob_no_body / ob_bare_body) [ob_date] [language]
  ob_long_form = itu_prefix [(sector space)] "Operational Bulletin" as _op_bull space "No." space number [document_date] [language]
  special_publication = ob_with_sector / ob_long_form
  annex_to_identifier = "Annex to" space (special_publication as annex_to)
  handbook = itu_prefix sector space number dot "HDB" as handbook_marker [document_date]
  numeric_question = itu_prefix sector space number parts ("/" digits as study_group) [":" as question_colon]
  question_tail = number [("/BL" as has_bl)] "/" digits as study_group
  letter_question = itu_prefix sector space series dot ((("[" as bracketed) question_tail "]") / question_tail) [":" as question_colon]
  common_text_twin = (space "|" space (1*non_pipe)) as common_text_twin

  identifier = common_text_identifier / itu_identifier
  any_char = %x00-10FFFF
  radio_regulations = itu_prefix ("R") as sector space "RR" as radio_regulations [(date_part / (dash (4digit) as year))] [language] !any_char
  itu_identifier = annex_to_identifier / special_publication / supplement_identifier / annex_identifier / appendix_identifier / report_identifier / handbook / numeric_question / letter_question / radio_regulations / with_series / contribution / series_code_identifier / without_series / publication_id
  common_text_identifier = itu_identifier common_text_twin

  entry identifier: identifier

  test {
    accept "ITU-R BT.500"
    accept "Recommendation ITU-T G.650.1 (09/2020)"
    accept "ITU-R SA.3631 Annex A"
    accept "ITU-T OB.101 (2016)"
    accept "Annex to ITU-T OB.101"
    accept "ITU-T E.164/2"
    accept "ITU-T 55/13:"
    accept "ITU-T G.984.2 Amd. 1 (2010)"
    accept "ITU-T G.650.1B"
    reject "nonsense"
  }
}
